alignments.note: Existential אַיִן with its supplied dummy and copula; head on the negation word (rule 50).
Waw plus the second existential negative fused into one word, headed on the negative (rule 35).

One substantive rendered by a two-word phrase; *gloom* is what names the thing and *thick* the specifier, so the head is *gloom* (rule 31). The competing reading heads on *thick* as the lexeme-bearing modifier.
The ASV writes no function word for the preposition: the modal belongs to the infinitive and *Where* to the resumptive adverb (rules 40, 52).
Infinitive with its supplied modal; the reflexive renders the Niphal's own voice and stays with the verb (rules 52, 44).
The resumptive adverb is what the ASV's *Where* realizes; no relative morpheme stands in the clause to compete for it.
Anarthrous substantival participle takes the supplied *the* (rule 46).

review_notes: *Where* was given to שָׁם rather than left added, since that adverb is the morpheme the relative adverb realizes.
